items.heading: Swedish Meatballs
details: Key ingredients: ground beef and pork, breadcrumbs, cream sauce
Mix ground beef and pork with breadcrumbs, egg and onion.
Roll into small round meatballs.
Fry until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Make a creamy pan sauce and serve the meatballs with lingonberry jam.

items.heading: Gravlax
details: Key ingredients: salmon, salt, sugar, dill
Coat a fresh salmon fillet with a mix of salt, sugar and crushed pepper.
Pack fresh dill generously over the fish.
Wrap tightly and cure in the refrigerator for a couple of days, turning occasionally.
Scrape off the cure and slice the salmon thinly to serve.
